title: Choose flopwire's admin-console visual world
question: The restrained direction fits the health-first brief. Keep it, re-roll, or explicitly choose the familiar category standard.

options.label: Ref Log Control Plane
options.lineage: Git reflogs, status porcelain, merge queues, and operator runbooks
options.body: A calm operational surface where every state change reads as attributable history. The first view is one ingestion-to-index pipeline with freshness, pressure, and failure shown in place—not a grid of metric cards. Restrained graphite, paper white, and one state color keep the interface quiet. Honest risk: it may feel overly developer-specific to a nontechnical administrator.
